name: message-outline
title: Message Outline
description: A long message with its outline: once it is 3 views tall and has two headings or more, its headings beside it where there is room, sticking to the top (the section being read marked, those read darker, how far the reader is, previous and next section, open in a reader), and otherwise a button sticking to the top that says the section being read and opens the outline, or nothing with pill false (e.g. beside a ConversationMinimap, which has its sections); while more than a view is below, a button at the bottom jumps to its end. A heading chosen scrolls into view and takes focus.
